The '''Yi'Tsarin River''' was a river on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Talus/Legends|Talus]]. It flowed through from the [[Derik'hur Highlands]] to the [[Akazi Plains]], reaching the [[Ocean/Legends|sea]] after crossing the [[Yi'Tsarin River Canyon]].<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Yi'Tsarin River appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
